author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: Closed outer whorl flaring into a lower-right lip that returns to junction J, with one inner coil leaving J and winding 9 units inside, as in the reference. Smooth Hermite cubics with axis-aligned tangents at the SQUARE extremes. Reads as a snail/sea shell at 48 in both themes.
omissions: Reference has about two inner turns; only one fits at 8+ spacing.
